Construction Services in Wichita, KS

Wichita is the largest city in Kansas and the anchor of the metro Wheatland Construction serves. With roughly 400,000 residents and a housing stock that spans more than a century — from 1910s and 1920s Craftsman bungalows in College Hill and Riverside, to 1950s and 1960s ranches across the south and east sides, to 1980s and 1990s suburban construction in the northeast and northwest quadrants, to new construction in the developing edges — Wichita presents nearly every residential construction challenge that exists.

Wheatland Construction is based in El Dorado, Butler County — but Wichita is our largest single service area. We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, family-owned since 2018. We permit through the City of Wichita for all in-city work and we're familiar with the city's building inspection process across its many districts.

What We Build in Wichita

Custom Homes

Wichita has active residential development in multiple quadrants — northeast along K-96, northwest toward Maize, southeast toward Derby and Mulvane, and south toward Haysville. We build custom homes in Wichita on available lots from foundation through finish, with City of Wichita permits and our own crews throughout. See Custom Home Building in Wichita →

Home Additions

Wichita's established neighborhoods — from the Historic Northeast to the Riverside area, from College Hill to the Eastside — have housing stock at every stage of renovation need. Room additions, master suite buildouts, garage expansions, and sunrooms are common. We match existing exterior materials, rooflines, and architectural character precisely. See Home Additions in Wichita →

Basement Finishing

Wichita basements range from pre-1940 block and stone foundations in the oldest neighborhoods to 2000s poured-concrete in newer subdivisions. Each type needs different handling. Pre-1960 basements need thorough moisture assessment and often drainage work before framing. Newer basements are generally more straightforward. We assess every Wichita basement before quoting a finishing scope. See Basement Finishing in Wichita →

Bathroom Remodeling

The range of Wichita bathroom remodel needs is as wide as the city's housing history — original 1920s bathrooms with cast-iron plumbing and hex tile in Riverside, 1960s bathrooms with original fiberglass and galvanized supply in the south side ranches, 1990s builder-grade bathrooms in the northeast suburbs. We remodel all of them, with scope appropriate to what the home needs. See Bathroom Remodeling in Wichita →

Kitchen Remodeling

Wichita kitchens are among our most active remodel service. From 1920s galley kitchens with no island and minimal counter space, to 1970s oak-cabinet layouts, to 1990s laminate countertop kitchens — the need to update is constant across the city's housing age spectrum. We handle full kitchen renovations and targeted refreshes, with City of Wichita permits. See Kitchen Remodeling in Wichita →

Major Remodels

Wichita's older housing stock — the pre-1960 homes in the city's established neighborhoods — frequently needs comprehensive renovation. Original electrical, original plumbing, plaster walls, and finish from decades ago that has been painted over and patched but never replaced. We handle major remodel scopes with coordinated trades and full permit management. See Major Remodels in Wichita →

Roofing

Wichita sits in Kansas's hail corridor — the city sees significant hail activity each spring. We install roofing systems appropriate for Wichita's storm exposure, handle insurance claim documentation when applicable, and pull all City of Wichita permits. See Roofing in Wichita →

Wichita Permit Office

All residential construction within Wichita city limits permits through the City of Wichita's Building Inspection Division. The city has specific permit requirements for work in historic districts (including parts of College Hill, Riverside, and the Near East Side) that differ from standard residential permitting. We know the difference and handle all applications appropriately.
